item.long_boost.desc: Growth Potion: Greatly increases player size for 8 seconds.
item.life_elixir.desc: Life Elixir: Charges gauge by 500. A mystical rainbow potion.
item.aipill.desc: AI Pill: Transforms your body into a robot that auto-guards most attacks, but gauge drains with each guard. Ends when gauge depletes.
item.wall.desc: Brick: Places a defensive brick wall on the ground to block the ball.
item.speedboots.desc: Speed Boots: Increases player movement speed.
item.gravitybelt.desc: Zero-G Belt: Enables instant direction changes while moving.
item.speedgear.desc: Correction Belt: Increases left/right direction change speed.
item.battery.desc: Battery Pack: Gauge carries over to the next stage.
item.revival.desc: Revival: Grants one rematch chance on defeat. Consumed on use. Only spawns once per game.
item.master.desc: Thor's Hammer: Extends brick length when using brick items and slightly reduces item cooldown.
item.cooltime.desc: Cooling Ball: Reduces item reuse cooldown.
item.chargebag.desc: Charge Bag: Gain bonus gauge charge each time the ball hits a wall.
item.spikeboots.desc: Spike Boots: High-tech gear that helps you use dash more skillfully.
item.bulkup.desc: Bulk-Up Suit: Titanium suit that permanently increases player size.
item.sensor.desc: Danger Sensor Belt: Automatically dashes when facing danger. Auto-dash doesn't consume gauge and adds a purple dash token.
item.dashholder.desc: Dash Holder: Grants additional dash tokens.
item.dowsing_pendulum.desc: Dowsing Pendulum: Emits a powerful magnetic field that attracts items within 150-250px range.
item.molotov.desc: Molotov: Throws a molotov to block enemy movement paths.
item.grenade.desc: Grenade: On hit, knocks back and stuns the enemy within blast radius.
item.spider_mine.desc: Spider Mine: Crawls along walls to plant mines in boss corners. Explodes and slows on contact.
item.flare.desc: Flare: After a delay, a flash explodes at the target location, causing confusion on hit.
item.smoke_grenade.desc: Smoke Grenade: Creates smoke near the player. Smoke slows fast balls and blocks boss skill attacks.
item.pandora_box.desc: Pandora's Box: Creates a rainbow black hole that showers items!
item.commando_arm.desc: Commando Arm: A veteran commando's gauntlet. Skip preparation for throwables and handle defensive items more skillfully.
item.stopwatch.desc: Stopwatch: Distorts time to freeze ball movement temporarily.
item.repair_kit.desc: Repair Kit: Instantly repairs Baltor's turret, divine stones, and placed bricks, removing overheat.
item.devil_dice.desc: Devil's Dice: Randomly changes all stats. The outcome is up to fate.
item.technical_vest.desc: Technical Vest: Has a chance to emit smoke on ball contact. Smoke blocks various boss skills.
item.fuel_pouch.desc: Fuel Pouch: Increases maximum gauge capacity.
item.bluetooth_ring.desc: Bluetooth Ring: Increases gauge gained when hitting the ball.
item.foul_whistle.desc: Foul Whistle: On round loss, chance for the referee to blow the whistle, nullifying the round and starting a rematch.
item.star_detector.desc: Star Detector: When star points drop, additional stars may appear.
item.bulletproof_hat.desc: Bulletproof Hat: Increases stun resistance, reducing stun duration.
item.spiked_helmet.desc: Spiked Helmet: Increases knockback resistance, reducing knockback distance and duration.
item.smartphone.desc: Smartphone: Auto-uses potions when gauge is low and auto-activates stopwatch in emergencies.
item.knee_pads.desc: Kick Charger: Charges gauge when hitting the ball with half-dash. Golden kick booster flashes on success.
item.doping_potion.desc: Doping Potion: For 8 seconds, doubles headshot/legshot chance and greatly increases pistol fire rate.
item.vitamin_pill.desc: Vitamin Pill: Greatly increases movement speed for 10 seconds.
item.berserk_potion.desc: Berserk Potion: Baltor-exclusive buff. Triples build/upgrade speed and greatly increases gauge gain for 15 seconds.
item.ammo_box.desc: Ammo Box: Fully reloads all non-obsolete firearms.
item.fire_support.desc: Fire Support: Calls in a bomber to drop 5-7 bombs on enemy territory.
item.net_gun.desc: Net Gun: Fires a net harpoon. On capture, the boss is trapped. Mash left/right to tighten the net.
item.ak47.desc: AK-47: Powerful automatic rifle. 90-round magazine with rapid fire. Faster than bazooka. Requires reload after emptying.
item.suicide_drone.desc: Suicide Drone: Commando-exclusive drone slot deployed via supply request skill.
item.laser_scope.desc: Laser Scope: Displays laser trajectories for all boss balls. Precisely predicts where balls will land.
item.holy_barrier.desc: Holy Barrier: Summons a holy barrier at the bottom of the screen behind the player.
item.dash_boost.desc: Dash Boost: Instantly removes dash token cooldown and after-delay for a period!
item.weather_capsule.desc: Weather Capsule: Immediately ends the current weather event.
item.dynamite.desc: Dynamite: A powerful explosive thrown toward the boss. Explodes after a 7-second countdown.
item.banana.desc: Banana: Thrown toward the boss. Boss slips when stepped on.
item.regeneration_potion.desc: Regen Potion: Resets all skill cooldowns and restores all dash tokens.
item.gold_bar.desc: Gold Bar: Precious metal that can be sold at shops for a high price.
item.gold_digger.desc: Gold Digger: A skilled miner's golden gloves. Increases gold gain by 30%-70% when equipped.
item.hero_seal.desc: Hero's Seal: A champion hero's seal from the colosseum. Equip as accessory to summon the hero in arcade mode.
item.ragnarok_hammer.desc: Ragnarok Hammer: The legendary hammer that heralds twilight of the gods! The mightiest weapon of Norse mythology awakens!
item.hermes_shoes.desc: Hermes' Shoes: The legendary winged sandals of the divine messenger! Receive the blessing of the fastest Greek god!
item.poseidon_trident.desc: Poseidon's Trident: The legendary trident wielded by the god of the sea! The power of the ocean is with you!
item.angel_blessing.desc: Angel's Blessing: Roll the angel's dice at stage start to receive 1-3 random blessings.
item.sacred_laurel.desc: Sacred Laurel: Sacred laurel leaves orbit the player in a ring formation for protection.
item.transcendent_crown.desc: Transcendent Crown: Increases all perk levels.
item.odins_eye.desc: Odin's Eye: On round defeat, chance to revive with Odin's spirit.

skill.tree.dash.desc: Boost attack tempo by increasing dash speed and control.
skill.tree.item.desc: Strengthen support abilities through field drop rates, gacha, and item cooldowns.
skill.tree.paddle.desc: Paddle skill tree is being restructured.
skill.tree.downtown.desc: Downtown skills that boost gacha reruns and mythic item rates.
skill.tree.blacksmith.desc: Valtor-exclusive skills. Enhances turret/divine upgrades and build efficiency.
skill.dash_spirit.desc:
30% chance to create laser afterimage on dash
(Lv2: 50% chance)
(Requires ★12 total)
skill.item_luck.desc:
Item spawn delay -6%
Lv5 bonus: additional -6% delay
skill.item_gauge_mastery.desc:
Gauge +7 on active item use
(Requires ★4 total)
skill.item_caffeine.desc:
Timed active item duration +15%
(Enlarge Potion, Vitamin, Laser Scope, Doping, etc.)
(Requires ★8 total)
skill.item_polish.desc:
Passive item roll option efficiency +20%
(+10% per additional level)
(Requires ★8 total)
skill.item_recycle.desc:
20% chance to keep used item via alchemy
(Requires ★12 total)
skill.downtown_gamble.desc: 25% chance for extra gacha after pull
skill.blacksmith_turret_enhance.desc:
Upgrade turret to enhanced turret.
(Guided missiles, Overdrive available)
skill.blacksmith_divine_enhance.desc:
Upgrade Divine Stone to enhanced version.
(Sword aura, Divine Shield available)
skill.blacksmith_hammer_shock.desc:
Unlock Hammer Shock skill.
Lv.1: Basic Hammer Shock
Lv.2: Wider range, stronger damage
Lv.3: Max range, max damage
skill.blacksmith_gauge_efficiency.desc:
Gauge gain +10% when blocking with Thor Shield
(Requires ★4 total)

legend.phoenix_feather.desc: Revive once with 50% HP on game over
legend.chronos_clock.desc: Press Space to slow time for 3 seconds (30s cooldown)
legend.chronos_clock.unlock: Score 10,000+ points in a single game
legend.excalibur_blade.unlock: Defeat boss within 30 seconds in a round
legend.poseidon_trident.desc: Creates a massive water vortex on dash (Roll: Cooldown)
legend.divine_stone.desc: Intercepts incoming boss ball with lightning every 10 seconds
legend.ragnarok_hammer.desc: Chance to knockback + stun boss on ball catch (Roll applied)
legend.sacred_laurel.desc: Laurel leaves orbit around player for protection (Roll: 3~8 leaves)
legend.angel_blessing.desc: Roll angel dice for buffs at stage start (Roll: Buff Lv1~5)

hero_skill.dark_slash.desc: Slash the ball diagonally, freezing time. When released, the ball accelerates 4x.
hero_skill.demon_step.desc: Cloak in darkness and rush to enemy territory. Speed x3, paddle size +20%.
hero_skill.tentacle_wrap.desc: Wrap tentacles around the enemy paddle, reducing speed by 60%.
hero_skill.abyss_ink.desc: Fire deep-sea ink to block the enemy's vision and cause confusion.
hero_skill.gravity_control.desc: Manipulate gravity so the ball is constantly pulled downward.
hero_skill.dwarf_magic.desc: Fire purple sparkle dust to shrink the enemy paddle.
hero_skill.hell_fire.desc: The ball turns into a will-o'-wisp, moving unpredictably.
hero_skill.horn_charge.desc: Charge forward to push back and stun the enemy.
hero_skill.puppet_control.desc: Pull the enemy with strings, kiss them, then send them back.
hero_skill.doll_curse.desc: Reverse enemy controls with a cursed doll, while guardian dolls block the ball.
hero_skill.dragon_breath.desc: Breathe dragon fire to strike and accelerate the ball.
hero_skill.dragon_wing.desc: Stir up wind with dragon wings to alter the ball's trajectory.
hero_skill.steam_barrier.desc: Create a steam shield that reflects the ball.
hero_skill.oil_spill.desc: Throw 2 oil blobs to create puddles in enemy territory. 30% slow while stepping on them.
hero_skill.shadow_clone.desc: Summon shadow clones that reflect the ball.
hero_skill.illusion_shuriken.desc: Fire 3-5 shurikens in sequence to knock back the enemy.
hero_skill.charm.desc: Fire magnetic energy to convert enemy guards to allies for 10-20 seconds.
hero_skill.riddle_trick.desc: Perform an unpredictable trick that activates a random skill.
hero_skill.ghost_summon.desc: Summon 2 ghost paddles at mid-field that hit the ball toward the enemy.
hero_skill.skeleton_archer.desc: Summon a skeleton archer in your territory. Shoots arrows at the enemy; dies if hit by ball. 20% golden archer chance.
hero_skill.bone_barrier.desc: Build a sharp bone wall in your territory. Reflects the ball once, then shatters.
hero_skill.balloon_wall.desc: Place a balloon barrier at mid-screen that deflects the ball.
hero_skill.bomb_surprise.desc: Attach a time bomb to the ball! Bounces between paddles, knockback + stun on explosion.
hero_skill.gatling_burst.desc: 1 sec aim, then 3 sec gatling barrage! Movement speed -50% while firing.
hero_skill.sand_prison.desc: Trap the enemy in a sand prison, limiting movement to 200-300px.
hero_skill.sand_vortex.desc: Fire 2 sand whirlwinds that pull the ball toward them.
hero_skill.solar_bolt.desc: Strike the ball with solar lightning, reflecting it in the opposite direction.
hero_skill.thunder_orb.desc: Launch a powerful lightning orb that explodes in enemy territory, electrifying the area.
hero_skill.banana_slice.desc: Throw a banana peel; the enemy slips when stepping on it.
hero_skill.wild_roar.desc: A roar shockwave that accelerates the ball by 260% on contact.

char.smasher.desc:
Chain power smashes with gauge bursts.
The core striker who controls attack tempo.
char.commando.desc:
Reshapes the battlefield with supply drops.
Controls tempo through weapon switching.
char.baltor.desc:
Controls distance with Thor Shield.
Boosts offense and defense with forging.
char.optimus.desc:
In moments of crisis as battery drains,
aims for reversal through mech upgrades.
char.speed_racer.desc:
Instant acceleration and aerial drift.
Exploits openings with step feints.
char.power_smasher.desc:
One heavy power shot for reversal.
Maintains pressure even after collision.
char.guardian.desc:
Blocks lines with multi-layer barriers.
Completes counterattacks with precision.
char.tech_master.desc:
Hacks rhythm with drones and traps.
Multi-control through situational buffs.
char.mystic.desc:
Breaks timing with time distortion.
Overturns patterns with orbit disruption.
char.normal.desc:
Balanced basic character
Stable and reliable performance
char.smasher.desc2:
A character who uses powerful smash shots
Aggressive playstyle
char.commando.desc2:
Tactical play and strong willpower
Firearms item specialist
